name: Digital residency
question: Can an Australian obtain e-residency or a digital ID here, sign documents electronically, and how are those credentials renewed?
sources: the national e-government, digital ID or e-residency authority
official electronic signature or trust-service pages
fields: costs[]: item, amount, currency, aud, source, checked
rules: Record official digital residency, national digital ID and electronic signature routes, including whether they are open to foreigners and how credentials are renewed.
If there is no e-residency programme, say so and still note any official digital ID or e-signature service a visitor or remote founder might use.
Country first. Write a state or region record only when the digital ID or signature rule clearly differs.
